query: insert into session_context (session_id, organization_id, used_tokens, window_tokens, reported_at) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, to_timestamp($5::bigint / 1000.0)) on conflict (session_id) do update set used_tokens = excluded.used_tokens, window_tokens = coalesce(excluded.window_tokens, session_context.window_tokens), reported_at = excluded.reported_at
